messages:
olivia: Quick flag  partners are opening SEVs in multiple places. Can we set a tiny, deterministic first-hop for partner-originated incidents?

chris_oncall: +1. Proposal: single shared channel #partner-escalation-hub. First poster must include ORG=<org> CASE=<id> and a one-line impact. That triggers the bot to create a private bridge.

maria_partner_se: We'll wire our automation to that channel if the bot emits a stable warroom name and includes a short triage template. Also require 'relay-contact: <email>' in the first post.

incidents_bot: Trigger matched: ORG=zephyr CASE=Z-102. Warroom created: #warroom-zephyr-Z-102. Zoom: https://meet.redwood/2249999999. Triage template posted. Notifying @chris_oncall, @maria_partner_se. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/partners/sev-shortpath

chris_oncall: Triage template (bot): Impact:
ORG:
CASE ID:
Relay-contact:
Symptoms:
Mitigations tried:
Owner (org:user) [declare within 10m or default claim]
Escalation TTL: default 10m, partner override allowed

maria_partner_se: We'll provide relay-contact and a public ticket stub. Also request a handback checklist the bot posts on resolve: remediation summary, artifacts, SI validation rows, closure confirmation.

olivia: Next steps: Chris to add bot trigger & template (48h). Maria to share relay format (48h). Olivia to publish one-pager and schedule a 20m drill (next week).

incidents_bot: Reminder set: "Partner SEV drill" in 7 days.

olivia: Thanks all. A small deterministic path should cut down duplicated paging and speed customer comms.
